foldSeedRule: 4200 + zero-based fold index; same seeds across candidates

selection.baselinePolicy: Report all candidates, including any baseline advantage; official model must satisfy the academic MLP requirement.
selection.tieBreak: within tolerance of highest mean: fewer parameters, then candidate order

finalTraining: all 166 development examples; fixed 200 epochs; no validation or test for checkpoint selection
testPolicy: 42 reserved IDs; one final evaluation after selection; persist completion; never tune from test
reproducibility: repeat selected architecture on fold 1 with identical configuration; compare probabilities and history before final evaluation
